Instrument.name: The Gamma Ray and Neutron Detector (GRAND) for Dawn
Instrument.description: GRAND was a nuclear spectrometer that measured the spectrum of planetary gamma rays and neutrons originating from galactic cosmic ray interactions and the decay of radio elements within the regolith of the target body. This instrument used a total of 21 sensors with a very wide field of view to measure the elemental composition of both Vesta and Ceres.
